messages:
rachel (partnerships): starting thread for the Opal-Bridge SI co-sell pilot. goal: define handoff/NRE credit rules + account mapping matrix for marketplace-origin leads. run 6 weeks, sample set = 4 SIs.

priya (sales-eng): high-level ask: we need clarity on crediting when SI introduces customer vs marketplace lead. sometimes both touch same account.

tom (si-ops): propose: attribution priority = 1) marketplace lead (if matches SKU & listing owner), 2) SI-introduced lead (signed intake form), 3) organic inbound. explicit proof: marketplace lead = listing_id on intake, SI-intro = signed LOA or intake email thread.

sam (legal): LOA template exists. small note  if LOA contains any exclusivity clause, escalate to legal review. we should block claims until cleared.

carl (marketplace): for marketplace leads, we can surface the listing owner in payload. but marketplace partners sometimes co-list. we'll add co_owner_list field to webhook.

priya (sales-eng): for joint outreach, recommended cadence: 48h SI initial reach, 72h joint AE intro, then 5 business day follow-up. if AE not assigned -> regional AE gets auto-assignment.

rachel (partnerships): mapping: we'll maintain a master CSV in Confluence: columns = account_domain, region_owner, allowed_sis (pipe-separated), marketplace_sku_ids, notes. revops can sync nightly to SFDC.

tom (si-ops): enforcement: intake pipeline evaluates allowed_sis against partner tags. if not allowed, intake creates suggested SI list and sends notification to partner manager.

webhook-bot: staging: intake webhook schema updated: listing_id, listing_owner, co_owner_list, lead_source, sku_id, signed_loa, nda_flag. docs: https://internal.dev/hooks/opal-bridge (token OPALTEST)

priya (sales-eng): crediting for revenue: if SI is primary introducer -> 70/30 split crediting (SI/AEs). if marketplace referral only -> marketplace credit rules apply (as per marketplace contract). need revops to validate percentages.

sam (legal): also: any joint public announcement requires both parties' PR signoff. add 'announce_ok' boolean to intake if customer ok for a joint case study.

rachel (partnerships): dispute resolution: if AE disputes SI claim within 7 days, open escalations channel -> partner-ops@redwood. Collect claim evidence, LOA, last outreach times. Revops adjudicates.

tom (si-ops): telemetry: emit partner_claim events: {lead_id, claimant, method, evidence_url, timestamp, adjudication_status}. we'll log to partner_claim_history table.

carl (marketplace): one wrinkle: HW partners sometimes bring system integrators as preferred integrators. add partner_type to mapping: SI vs HW-SI. HW-SI gets higher priority only for hardware-bound SKUs.

rachel (partnerships): action items: 1) revops to create CSV schema & SFDC sync (tomorrow EOD) 2) legal to confirm LOA gating logic (sam, EOD+2) 3) marketplace to add co_owner_list to webhook (carl, staging now) 4) si-ops to add partner_claim_history schema (tom, EOD) 5) partnerships to share pilot partner list & kickoff invite (rachel, today). reply here if you want to join daily stand.

priya (sales-eng): i'll join daily. want to watch attribution edge-cases.

sam (legal): will review LOA.

carl (marketplace): swagger update in staging pushed.

tom (si-ops): prepping DB migration. expect minor downtime window Wed 01:00-01:10 UTC.

rachel (partnerships): perfect. locking this plan unless objections. thanks all :tada:
